name: kaoyan-english-lab
description: A practical MVP study app for Chinese postgraduate English exam preparation.

scripts.electron:build: pnpm --dir frontend build && pnpm --dir electron start
scripts.electron:dev: concurrently "cmd /c set PORT=3001&& pnpm --dir backend start" "powershell -NoProfile -Command Start-Sleep -Seconds 3; cmd /c set ELECTRON_EXTERNAL_BACKEND=1&& set ELECTRON_BACKEND_PORT=3001&& npx electron ."
scripts.package:win: pnpm --dir frontend build && pnpm --dir electron package:win
